title: Writer count facts accept digit and standalone English word equivalence without weakening detail checks
steps: Run the site copy count-fact tests against the real W04 checker with a cited two-studio fact and unsupported details.
expect: A digit count 2 passes when its cited fact states two Dubai studios; uppercase words and created-page facts work without editing copy.
Unsupported age 18 and uncited counts still fail.
Compound-number fragments and words inside email addresses or links never supply a count.
Decimals, leading-zero numbers, times, phones and addresses retain their existing exact checks.
fence: W04 number backing uses only standalone English cardinal words in the already allowed facts; all other detail kinds retain exact matching

tests: W04 accepts a digit count backed by a cited standalone English number word
W04 keeps unsupported counts and uncited count facts out of writer copy
W04 never takes part of a compound number or an address as a count word
W04 number-word equivalence leaves decimals, times, phones and links exact
